scope: Conservative sample of actual public-hospital inpatient addresses. Not complete regional register and not a shared clinical emergency profile.
sourceType: Official public hospital pages with explicit inpatient addresses, supplemented by Roszdravnadzor licence extract for Gdov (2025-08-04)
sourceDateNote: Pskov webpage publication dates unstated; retrieval date must not be presented as a statistical reference year.
selectionPolicy: Exact street/house and hospital building tag matched to OSM; conflicts excluded and documented in facilities_excluded.json.
coordinateMethod: Shapely representative point inside actual OSM area polygon; not a verified vehicle entrance or hospital reception.
